title: Luxon faction
wikitext:
[[File:Faction_(Luxon).jpg|right]][[Luxon faction]] is a representation of the efforts you have made in support of the [[Luxon]]s, and by extent your reputation with the Luxon Armada. Your current amount of Luxon faction can be seen on the faction tab of the [[Hero panel]].

== Acquisition ==
There are seven main ways to gain Luxon faction:
#Completing [[:Category:Rewards Luxon faction|quests]] in [[the Jade Sea]] region of [[Cantha]], where the Luxons live.
#Completing the [[Boreas Seabed]], [[Gyala Hatchery]], and [[Unwaking Waters]] missions the first time per [[character]].
#Playing in the Luxon [[challenge mission]]s ([[Zos Shivros Channel]] and [[The Aurios Mines]]).
#Killing foes in [[The Deep]].
#Obtaining [[Blessing of the Luxons]] from a Luxon Priest outside of most cities or outposts controlled by Luxon, and then [[kill]]ing [[foe]]s while in the [[explorable area]] the blessing was obtained. Price is {{cost|100}} if you are Luxon, and {{cost|150}} if you are Kurzick ({{cost|50}} for a bribe, {{cost|100}} for the blessing; you also gain Luxon faction for the bribe), and the blessing will disappear if you change [[zone]]s.
#[[Vanquisher|Vanquishing]] explorable areas in the Jade Sea.
#Trading in [[Imperial faction]].

== [[Faction rewards]] ==

Luxon faction can be traded to a [[Luxon Scavenger]] for the following: 

{| {{STDT}} align="center"
|- style="background:lightgray;"
! Method !! Faction spent !! [[Allegiance rank|Title points]] gained !! Notes
|-
| Donate faction points to your [[guild]] ("Raise Alliance reputation")|| 5,000 || 10,000 || You must belong to a Luxon-[[allegiance|allied]] guild. A character [[Guild#Creating_a_guild|can create their own guild]] for this purpose.
|-
| Exchange faction points for [[Jadeite Shard]]s || 5,000 || 5,000 ||
|-
| Exchange faction points for [[Passage Scroll to the Deep|Passage Scrolls to the Deep]] || 1,000 || 1,000 ||
|-
| Exchange faction points for [[Allegiance skill|Luxon skills]] || 3,000 || 6,000 || Your character must be a [[level]] 20 [[roleplaying character]] that is a [[Allegiance rank|Luxon Supporter]] (rank 1)
|}

; Spending both faction types

Spending points for one faction causes an equal number of points to be deducted from both factions.

* There is no way to simultaneously farm both titles.
* Although sometimes you have little choice, it is always inefficient to simultaneously collect both types of faction.
* Some players will collect 10,000 points in both types in order for a character to complete both [[Befriending the Kurzicks]] and [[Befriending the Luxons]] quickly.

==Faction cap==
The faction cap is initially 10,000, and can be raised as high as 70,000 by completing various achievements. A [[Luxon Scavenger]] will list the missing achievements when asked about ''"Raising Luxon Faction cap"''.
{| {{STDT}}
! Achievement || Faction cap increase
|-
| Complete [[Befriending the Luxons]] for the first time || 10,000
|-
| Complete [[Unwaking Waters]] from the [[Luxon]]  side for the first time{{note|1}}|| 7,000
|-
| Defeat [[Kanaxai]] for the first time || 10,000
|-
| Score 100 points in [[Zos Shivros Channel]] for the first time || 1,000
|-
| Score 100 points in [[The Aurios Mines]] for the first time || 1,000
|-
| Win a match for the Luxons in [[Fort Aspenwood]] for the first time || 5,000
|-
| Win a match for the Luxons in [[Jade Quarry]] for the first time || 5,000
|-
| Win an [[Alliance battle|Alliance Battle]] for the Luxons for the first time || 5,000
|-
| Achieve rank 1 in the [[Allegiance rank|Friend of the Luxons]] title track || 5,000
|-
| Each additional rank in the Friend of the Luxons title track || 1,000
|}
# {{note link|1}}One needs to also complete Boreas Seabed and Gyala Hatchery.

==Notes==
To finish the [[Protector of Cantha]] title, one must do ''both'':
#Get 10,000 Luxon faction to complete [[Befriending the Luxons]] to open the [[Gyala Hatchery]] mission
#Get 10,000 [[Kurzick faction]] to complete [[Befriending the Kurzicks]] to open the [[The Eternal Grove]] mission.
